artifact: M9 seated waist and hip silhouette V2 review
summary: V1 made the pelvis component visible but remained too narrow and shallow to read as human hips in the production silhouette. V2 replaces that pointed bridge with a denser, broader seated waist-to-glute-to-thigh shell. A rounded posterior bulge supplies profile depth while a central saddle preserves two distinct thigh roots. The shell stays centered on each solved hip and changes no animation, collision, mass, raft contact, or gameplay force.

root_cause.v1_visibility_contract_gap: The V1 reference half-extent of 9.5 x 18.0 x 8.5 cm and minimum 9.0 x 16.0 x 7.9 cm contract proved component visibility, but allowed a pointed, visually disconnected pelvis with inadequate front/profile/rear body volume.
root_cause.rejected_first_v2_shape: A broad 15 x 23 x 15 cm shell with linear lower posterior bias restored hip volume but created a skirt-like lower edge in profile and rear review.
root_cause.retained_v2_shape: An 18-ring by 32-side shell uses rounded mid-volume shaping, a localized seated glute bulge, and a central lower saddle lift. Its production reference half-extent is 15 x 23 x 15 cm and its visibility contract requires at least 500 mesh vertices and 14 x 21 x 13.8 cm runtime half-extents.
